text: Zava update: SHP-24131 ETA 21 Oct. SHP-24138 (Vintage Port) e-AD resubmitted, earliest 23 Oct. Option: express road freight for €1,350 gets SHP-24138 to Lisbon on 21 Oct if you approve today.

FYI Northwind is restructuring purchasing – I heard their new category manager is talking to other Port houses for 2027.
